Nice to meet you.
I'm here in Mora studying ancient relics and artifacts. The new discoveries of Adventurers has made this village very exciting for me.
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
很高興見到你。
我在穆拉研究古代遺物和神器。冒險者們的新發現讓這座村莊變得非常令人興奮。

scripts.text: Tell me more...
scripts.translation: 告訴我更多...

scripts.text: Give abilities to artifacts.
scripts.translation: 賦予神器能力

scripts.text: Reset Enhanced abilities.
scripts.translation: 重置強化能力

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
New artifacts have been found here in Mora village, haven't you heard the news?
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
聽說穆拉村發現了新的神器，你聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
If you come across any of these artifacts, there are hidden powers that can be extracted from them.
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
如果你遇到這些神器，可以從中提取隱藏的力量。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
I'm going to continue my research for these artifacts. We researchers are taking Mora Coins as payment for our services...
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
我將繼續研究這些神器。我們研究員收取穆拉村硬幣作為服務費用...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
I'm offering my services to give abilities to the artifacts for 100,000 zeny and 1 Mora Coin.
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
我提供賦予神器能力的服務，費用是100,000 Zeny和1枚穆拉村硬幣。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
The best part of my service is that any enhancements that you have in these artifacts will not be harmed.
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
我服務最大的好處是，神器上已有的強化效果不會受到損害。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
I'm not giving these services out for free pal. 100,000 zeny and 1 Mora Coin. Is that too much to ask?
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
我可不會免費提供這些服務，朋友。100,000 Zeny和1枚穆拉村硬幣。這要求過分嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
Ok, so are you ready? Before I start working on this, what kind of equipment did you want me to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
好的，你準備好了嗎？在我開始工作之前，你想讓我強化哪種裝備？

scripts.text: I'm not wearing the equipment

請確保你先穿戴好該裝備。

scripts.translation:

^990099{0}^000000？？
我真的好想研究一下這件裝備...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
Mm-hmm something is wrong.
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
嗯...好像有點不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
It's a considerable reinforcement to the equipment. In this case extended enhancements can be granted. Which stat do you want to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
這對裝備是一次相當可觀的強化。在這種情況下，可以進行擴充套件強化。您想強化哪項屬性？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
Attempting to strengthen the ability further. The previous enforcement won't be affected. Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
正在嘗試進一步強化的能力。之前的強化效果不會受到影響。您要繼續嗎？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
正在嘗試第二次強化。之前的強化效果不會受到影響。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
I may have a chance to fail now with this attempt. Do you wish to continue?
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
這次嘗試我可能會失敗。您確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
Let's start the third enhancement. I can give the best stats at this stage but remember, ^990000there is now a chance for the artifact to be destroyed and previous enhancements will be erased^000000. Continue?
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
讓我們開始第三次強化。在這個階段，我可以賦予最好的屬性，但請記住，^990000神器現在有可能被摧毀，且之前的強化效果將被清除^000000。繼續嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Researcher]
This artifact has been strengthened to the limit. Further enhancement is impossible at its current state.
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
這件神器已經強化到了極限。以目前的狀態，無法再進行強化。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.

scripts.text: Please continue!

Well I guess I was wrong...
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
看來我猜錯了...

[Artifact Researcher]
I think there was an enhancing limit to the artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[神器研究員]
我想神器是有強化上限的。

[Artifact Researcher]
I'm not going to do the work unless you pay the fee.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: 在繼續之前，請先減少背包中的物品數量。

scripts.translation: 您的背包物品過多。

scripts.text:
Those Mora Artifacts look so perfect!
But I know you want them to be even better!
scripts.translation:
那些穆拉神器看起來太完美了！
但我知道你想讓它們變得更好！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Greetings Adventurer. We will be great friends in a moment after I tell you how to Empower your Artifacts!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
冒險者，您好。在我告訴您如何強化神器之後，我們很快就會成為好朋友！

scripts.text: Let's do this!
scripts.translation: 讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text: Empower Artifacts?
scripts.translation: 強化神器？

scripts.text: Nope, not for me!
scripts.translation: 不了，我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
You seem like a pretty good judge of character.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
看來你很有眼光。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
For over 200 years I've been working with Artifacts here in Mora. Toiling to get the perfect +9!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我在穆拉研究神器已經超過200年了。為了打造完美的+9神器，我付出了無數的心血！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
My business is collecting the old relics and refining them to their essence!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我的工作是收集古老的遺物，並提煉出它們的精華！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Finding the perfect Artifact for me to experiment on is my life's work.
Plus seeing the wonder of our ancestor's legacy is also gratifying.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
尋找完美的神器供我實驗，是我畢生的事業。
此外，見證祖先留下的奇蹟遺產，也是一件令人欣慰的事。

scripts.text: I can see how that could be fun.
scripts.translation: 我明白那確實很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Thank you human.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
謝謝你，人類。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
I've been doing this for over 200 years, and honestly the readily available supply is gone, and Artificer and Artifact Crafter won't trade me anymore...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我從事這項工作已經超過200年了，說實話，現成的材料已經用完了，而且工匠和神器工匠也不願意再和我交易了...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
But maybe the Humans that are starting to visit can bring in some new stock!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
不過，也許最近開始來訪的人類能帶來一些新的庫存！

scripts.text: Humans... Stock?
scripts.translation: 人類...庫存？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Yes! If the humans can bring me new artifacts I can work on my ultimate achievement!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
沒錯！如果人類能給我帶來新的神器，我就能完成我的終極成就！

scripts.text: Ultimate Achievement?
scripts.translation: 終極成就？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Patience, we'll get to that...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
耐心點，我們馬上就會談到那個...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
I am a collector, by trade, but my greatest achievement is empowering some artifacts with greater power!
I have only perfected my ability on a few Artifact types so far.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我的職業是收藏家，但我最大的成就是賦予某些神器更強大的力量！
目前，我只在少數幾種神器上完美掌握了這項能力。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
You might just be the human to help me complete my plan.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
你也許就是那個能幫我完成計劃的人類。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Oh how I love how fate works sometimes...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
命運有時真是奇妙...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
+1, +2, +3, +4, +5, +6 those refinements are not strong enough to work on my craft.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
+1, +2, +3, +4, +5, +6，這些強化等級還不夠強，無法用於我的工藝。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
But +7! +7 is rare and just barely strong enough to work in my crafting attempts.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
但是+7！+7很稀有，勉強足夠用於我的強化嘗試。

scripts.text: I'm gonna be abused again...
scripts.translation: 我好像又要被坑了...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Right you are! I know it is natural for you Humans to help a friend, even without the friend asking...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
你說得對！我知道你們人類天生樂於幫助朋友，即使朋友沒有開口請求...

scripts.text: I'm not sure if...
scripts.translation: 我不確定...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Of course I'll accept your help!  Find me...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]

Well aside from the +7, there are very specific enchantments that need to be on the artifact that help catalyze the process.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
除了+7之外，神器上還需要有特定的附魔，才能催化這個過程。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
If either the +7 or the specific enchantment is missing I can't do it.
scripts.translation:

如果缺少+7或者特定的附魔，我就無法進行製作。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]

scripts.translation:

不會保留，但你會得到更好的東西！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]

scripts.translation:

現在，你是不是更想了解我正在尋找的神器了？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

祝你今天愉快。再見~

Let me take a look at what you have brought me.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
讓我看看你帶來了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]

scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]

scripts.text:

你手中的武器並不是我能處理的神器。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
I must insist that the refine level of the Artifact be at least +7!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我必須堅持，神器的強化等級至少要是+7！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
These attributes just won't do for my research process, try re-randoming them.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
這些屬性對我的研究過程來說不夠好，請嘗試重新隨機一下。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
I'm tingling with excitement!
You've brought me everything I need!!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我興奮得渾身發抖！
你帶來了我所需要的一切！！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
If you are ready I am about to show you what I can do with your +{0} Artifact!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
如果你準備好了，我就開始展示我對你的+{0}神器能做什麼了！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
I'm going to take your ^FF0000{0}^000000 and exchange it, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我要拿走你的^FF0000{0}^000000並進行交換，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: NOOO!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text: Yes, I'm ready!
scripts.translation: 是的，我準備好了！

scripts.text: What will it be after?
scripts.translation: 之後會變成什麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
You've got to be kidding... you got my hopes up...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
你在開玩笑吧...你讓我滿懷期待...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Surely you want to go on?
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
你確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, do it!
scripts.translation: 是的，做吧！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
You've got to be kidding... you got my hopes up...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
你在開玩笑吧...你讓我滿懷期待...

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
It is perfectly done, you will be so happy! Good bye friend~
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
完美完成了，你會很開心的！再見，朋友~

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
With my touch, I can turn a typical army padding into a piece of art. I'm Kay the Master Tailor, creating art with army paddings.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
憑藉我的手藝，我能將普通的軍用內衣變成藝術品。我是裁縫大師凱，用軍用內衣創造藝術。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Well, what's in a name? I can turn your army padding into a piece of art if you bring ^ff00005 Mora Coins and an Army Padding^000000.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
名字什麼的無所謂。只要你帶著^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣和一件軍用內衣^000000，我就能把它變成藝術品。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
I happen to have a few army paddings in stock. Would you like to buy one? The price is 1 Mora Coin. So cheap.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
我正好有幾件軍用內衣存貨。你想買一件嗎？只要1枚穆拉村硬幣。很便宜吧。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text: I'll buy one now.
scripts.translation: 我現在買一件

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Okay, I understand.
Come back for one if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
好的，我明白了。
如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Here it is.
It's very nice and fluffy. Please come back.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
給你。
非常柔軟蓬鬆。請下次再來。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Have you come to add art to one of your army paddings?
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
你是來給你的軍用內衣增添藝術感的嗎？

scripts.text: Please tell me more.
scripts.translation: 請多告訴我一些

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我聽過。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
A typical army padding isn't warm enough. It feels rough on your skin and doesn't look good. And artistic value? It has next to none.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
普通的軍用內衣不夠保暖。穿在身上粗糙，外觀也不好看。至於藝術價值？幾乎為零。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
However, I'll embroider it with velvet threads, and add three options to it.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
不過，我會用天鵝絨線進行刺繡，並新增三個選項。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Bring me ^8888005 Mora Coins^000000 and an Army Padding, and we can add some art together!
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
帶著^8888005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000和一件軍用內衣來找我，我們一起創造藝術吧！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
I'm telling you just in case - I'll do whatever I need to do with your army padding, whether it's brand-new or has been mended before.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
順便提醒一下——無論你的軍用內衣是全新的還是修補過的，我都會按我的方式處理。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
So if you have with you an army padding mended to your liking, put it in a safe place and come back.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
所以，如果你有一件修補得合心意的軍用內衣，請把它放在安全的地方，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
And another thing - once I fail to add art to it, it becomes unusable... you'll need to buy a new one in that case.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
還有一件事——如果我新增藝術效果失敗，它就會變得無法使用...到時候你需要買一件新的。

scripts.text: Come on, what's the rush?
scripts.translation: 別急，慢慢來

scripts.text: Okay! Let's do it!!
scripts.translation: 好的！開始吧！！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
What's wrong with you?
The villagers keep me busy enough.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
你怎麼了？
村民們已經讓我忙得不可開交了。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
It looks like you don't have everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
看起來你缺少必要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
You have to have 5 Mora Coins and an Army Padding with you before I can do my work.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
在我開始工作之前，你必須攜帶5枚穆拉村硬幣和一件軍用內衣。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Oh......
I can't believe I messed up.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
噢......
真不敢相信我搞砸了。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
I want to be alone. Go away!
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
我想一個人靜一靜。請離開！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
My art looks great.
scripts.translation:
[裁縫大師]
我的手藝真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
My job is to polish the stone in a Guardian's Pendant, and then carve a symbol with special power on it.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
我的工作是為<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜打磨石頭，並在上面雕刻出擁有特殊力量的符文。

scripts.text:

The process gives the Guardian's Pendant more power than an ordinary accessory.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
這個過程會讓<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜比普通的飾品擁有更強的力量。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
If you're interested, I can work on your pendant for ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000. Of course you need to have a Guardian's Pendant so I can work on with you.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
如果您感興趣，我可以為您加工<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜，費用是^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000。當然，您需要攜帶一個<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜，我才能為您加工。

scripts.text:

您是來升級<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜的嗎？

scripts.translation:

如果您感興趣，我可以為您加工<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜，費用是^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000。當然，您需要攜帶一個<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜，我才能為您加工。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
I'm telling you just in case - 
If I work on a Guardian's Pendant that's been upgraded before, it loses its original power.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
我提前告訴您一下——
如果我加工一個已經升級過的<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜，它會失去原本的力量。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
And worse, it can lose its power and become an ordinary pendant. Of course, stone is not as susceptible to damage as cloth, so you won't lose the pendant itself.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
更糟糕的是，它可能會失去力量，變成普通的吊墜。當然，石頭不像布料那樣容易損壞，所以您不會失去吊墜本身。

scripts.text: Come on, what's the rush?
scripts.translation: 別急，慢慢來

scripts.text: Okay! Let's do it!!
scripts.translation: 好的！開始吧！！

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
Come back when you're not in a hurry. I always have a lot of time on my hands.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
等您不忙的時候再來吧。我手頭總是有很多時間。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
It looks like you don't have everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
看起來您缺少必要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
You must have 5 Mora Coins and a Guardian's Pendant with you before I can do my work.
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
在我開始工作之前，您必須攜帶5枚穆拉村硬幣和一個<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的吊墜。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
What~!!
What on earth is wrong with it!!
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
什麼~！！
這到底是怎麼回事！！

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
Looks like I did it!
scripts.translation:
[吊墜工匠]
看起來我成功了！

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I'm Bulberry Westhood, keeping the tradition of quality hoods alive.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
我是布林貝里·韋斯特胡德，致力於傳承優質兜帽的傳統。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
我只處理優質物品——而不是市場上隨便買的圍巾。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
If you have anything that you think is of high enough quality, come find me with ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
如果您有認為足夠優質的物品，請帶著^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000來找我。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I can improve its high quality with my own hands.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
我可以用我的雙手提升它的高品質。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
So you have a Loki's Scarf 1042 Special Edition. You really have an eye for quality. Can I start working on it right away?
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
原來您有一條洛基圍巾 1042 特別版。您的眼光真不錯。我可以馬上開始工作嗎？

scripts.text: I don't get it.
scripts.translation: 我不明白。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Like I said, I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
正如我所說的，我只處理優質物品——而不是市場上隨便買的圍巾。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
This Loki's Scarf you have is awesome. It's a limited edition product with Loki's crest on it!
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
您這條洛基圍巾真是了不起。這是帶有洛基紋章的限量版產品！

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
My specialty is bringing out the hidden power at the small cost of... 
5 Mora Coins.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
我的專長是挖掘其隱藏的力量，代價僅為...
5枚穆拉村硬幣。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
如果您改變主意了，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I'm telling you just in case - 
If I work on a Loki's Scarf that's been upgraded before, it loses its original power.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
我事先說明一下——
如果我加工一條已經升級過的洛基圍巾，它會失去原有的力量。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
And worse, it can lose all its power becoming an ordinary scarf.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
更糟糕的是，它可能會失去所有力量，變成一條普通的圍巾。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Of course, the Loki's Scarf is a quality item, so you won't lose the scarf itself in the process.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
當然，洛基圍巾是優質物品，所以在過程中您不會失去圍巾本身。

scripts.text: Maybe later, sir...
scripts.translation: 也許以後吧，先生...

scripts.text: I'd like to own a quality item!
scripts.translation: 我想擁有一件優質物品！

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Ha...!
You say 'later' when you can have the best quality item right away? Well, have it your own way.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
哈...！
明明現在就能擁有最高品質的物品，您卻說“以後”？好吧，隨您便。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
It looks like you don't everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
看來您還沒有準備好所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
You must have 5 Mora Coins and a Loki's Scarf with you before you can have the best quality item.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
您需要持有5枚穆拉村硬幣和一條洛基圍巾，才能獲得最高品質的物品。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Aaarrgghh, this is impossible!
My! My Loki's Scarf!....
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
啊...啊...這不可能！
我的！我的洛基圍巾！....

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Oh, I apologize for my disgraceful behavior. I was too upset.
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
噢，我為我失態的行為道歉。我太激動了。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Fortunately, it's still in its original state before I started working on it. It's not torn or stretched. It's a quality item after all. Oh ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
幸好，它在我開始工作前還保持著原始狀態。沒有撕裂或變形。畢竟是優質物品嘛。哦呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Wow~ mission complete!
scripts.translation:
[布林貝里·韋斯特胡德]
哇~任務完成！
